parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Write one site note per station, in the order given, using exactly this template for each station:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Monokpo-street
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 2.2 - 3.2 m
Recommendation: Target the shallow conductive layer identified at this depth.

Station: Bank-road
Curve type: AK-type
Aquifer depth: 0 - 5.21 m
Recommendation: Drill into the primary top layer for shallow water extraction.

Station: Kenpoly-convocation-arena
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: 7.92 - 25.9 m
Recommendation: Target the third layer as the most viable aquifer zone.

Station: Kogam-street
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 0.822 - 6.45 m
Recommendation: Focus on the highly conductive shallow zone for production.

Station: Market-road
Curve type: AAK-type
Aquifer depth: 0 - 2.86 m
Recommendation: Target the immediate surface layer for water tapping.

Station: Tigidam-street
Curve type: KHA-type
Aquifer depth: 15.12 - 32 m
Recommendation: Aim to intercept the third layer at the specified depth interval.

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: 11.9 - 27.1 m
Recommendation: Target the third layer to achieve optimal borehole yield.

Station: BMGS-bori-field
Curve type: KQHA-type
Aquifer depth: 20.7 - 29.7 m
Recommendation: Drill to the fourth layer to strike the primary water-bearing zone.
